pk.Analyte: Zn (ICP-OES, increment over the control baseline)
pk.Notes: Rapid oral bioavailability screen: single gavage dose of 300 mg/kg in female BALB/c mice, 4-8 weeks, 15-20 g, two animals per compound, blood from the retro-orbital veins at 20 min, 1, 2 and 4 h, plasma analysed for zinc by ICP-OES and for platinum by ICP-MS. Zinc values are given relative to the control sample because the body carries a baseline zinc level, so they are an increment over background and not a total plasma concentration; the detection limit for zinc was 480 ug/L. Reported series in ug/L: complex 1 2278.50, 3029.50, 1715.50, 935.55; complex 2 727.83, 1023.55, 1191.95, 624.70 at 20 min, 1, 2 and 4 h. Section 2.6 states in one sentence that the 20 min concentration of complex 1 was its Cmax, which contradicts its own series, the abstract and section 2.6 of the next page, all of which give 3029.50 ug/L at 1 h; the value at 1 h is entered and the contradiction kept here. No AUC, clearance, volume of distribution or half-life is reported, and with two animals per group no dispersion is given. Treatment arm (column removed 2026-11-09): [Zn(atc-Et)2] 300 mg/kg single oral gavage. Cohort (column removed 2026-11-09): ijms17050781-pk-1. Group size basis (column removed 2026-11-09): cohort_all_assayed. Time origin (column removed 2026-11-09): first dose. Specimen (column removed 2026-11-09): plasma.
